result:
Clean — no stray processes or containers. Everything is implemented, tested, and verified end-to-end via Docker.

Summary of changes:
- **`client/status.rb`** (new) — compares local dir vs `GET /blobs` by key+SHA-256, printing "would upload"/"would download" sections; strictly read-only (only calls `list_blobs`, never `get_blob`/`put_blob`/`delete_blob`, never touches local files). A file diverged in content appears in both lists, since `status` reports what push and pull would each independently do — it doesn't apply the sync conflict-resolution rule (that's ticket 10). Returns 0 whenever the comparison itself succeeds.
- **`client/syncbox`** — wires `status` to `Syncbox::Status.run`; `sync` still prints the "not implemented yet" message with exit code 2.
- **`spec/status_spec.rb`** (new) — covers locally-new, server-only, and diverged files, no-op case, unreachable server, missing dir, and explicit assertions that no PUT/DELETE/content-GET requests are made and no local files are created/modified/deleted.

Verified via `run-tests` (90/90 passing) and manually end-to-end through `run-server`/`run-client` in Docker (including `--server` vs `SYNCBOX_SERVER` env var, and confirming local/server state is byte-for-byte unchanged after `status`).
